assertions.description: FontFace instances expose a width attribute (CSS Font Loading: [BindingAlias="stretch"] attribute CSSOMString width).
The FontFace constructor's width dictionary member is honoured: constructing with { width: "75%" } yields a face whose width attribute reads back "75%" (an ignored unknown member cannot pass this).
assertions.test: (() => { const f = new FontFace('conf-w', 'url(data:,)', { width: '75%' }); return 'width' in f && f.width === '75%'; })()

assertions.description: width and stretch are one attribute with two names: constructing with { stretch: "condensed" } reads back through width, and assigning width updates stretch.
assertions.test: (() => { const f = new FontFace('conf-a', 'url(data:,)', { stretch: 'condensed' }); if (!('width' in f) || f.width !== 'condensed') return false; f.width = 'expanded'; return f.stretch === 'expanded'; })()

assertions.description: The @font-face font-width descriptor parses and reads back through the CSSOM instead of being dropped.
assertions.test: (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); document.head.append(s); try { s.sheet.insertRule('@font-face { font-family: conf-fw; src: url("data:,"); font-width: 87.5%; }', 0); const st = s.sheet.cssRules[0].style; const v = st ? (st.getPropertyValue('font-width') || st.getPropertyValue('font-stretch')) : ''; return v !== ''; } catch (e) { return false; } finally { s.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: The legacy font-stretch descriptor spelling keeps working (it is an alias, not a removal).
assertions.test: (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); document.head.append(s); try { s.sheet.insertRule('@font-face { font-family: conf-fs; src: url("data:,"); font-stretch: 62.5%; }', 0); const st = s.sheet.cssRules[0].style; const v = st ? st.getPropertyValue('font-stretch') : ''; return v !== ''; } catch (e) { return false; } finally { s.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: A percentage on the width/stretch property family drives a real wdth variation axis: a variable font rendered at 200% must measure about twice the advance it measures at 100% (checked with a fontTools-built axis font, not a system font).
assertions.test: (async () => { const mod = await import('/v153/fontface-width-attribute-and-font-width-descriptor/showcase-width-font.js'); const face = new FontFace('ConfWVF', 'url(' + mod.WIDTH_VF_URI + ')', { stretch: '50% 200%' }); await face.load(); document.fonts.add(face); const mk = (pct) => { const el = document.createElement('span'); el.textContent = 'WIDTH'; el.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;visibility:hidden;font-family:ConfWVF;font-size:40px;font-stretch:' + pct; el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); document.body.append(el); return el; }; const a = mk('100%'); const b = mk('200%'); await document.fonts.ready; await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); const ratio = a.offsetWidth > 0 ? b.offsetWidth / a.offsetWidth : 0; a.remove(); b.remove(); document.fonts.delete(face); return ratio > 1.8 && ratio < 2.2; })()
